boundary_atlas.status: great-circle geodesic flow and ordinary spherical harmonics
stationary classical points; no primitive orbit is counted
time reversal pairs charge q with charge -q after reversing initial velocity on the same geometric circle; the conjugate bundle has identical spectrum
the classical equation is local but the frozen global degree-q line bundle does not exist
orbits occur in clean continuous circle families and are not isolated hyperbolic cycles
lowest monopole level has eigenvalue abs(q)/2 and multiplicity abs(q)+1
fixed curvature on the unique degree-q line bundle determines one unitary gauge class because H^1_dR(S^2)=0; the spectrum is gauge invariant
the smooth-section energy form has the Friedrichs realization, equal to the unique self-adjoint elliptic closure on compact boundaryless S^2

theorem_contract.boundaries: q=0 is the round geodesic and spherical-harmonic case; E=0 is stationary; nonintegral q has no frozen global line bundle
theorem_contract.bundle_connection_bridge: degree-q line bundles on S^2 are classified by c1 and every unitary connection with curvature i*(q/2)*dA is unitary-gauge equivalent to the standard homogeneous monopole connection because H^1_dR(S^2)=0
theorem_contract.heat_trace: Tr exp(-t Delta_q)=sum_n>=0 (2n+abs(q)+1) exp(-t lambda_nq) for t>0
theorem_contract.operator_realization: Delta_q is the Friedrichs realization of the nonnegative form integral |nabla s|^2 dA on smooth sections and equals the unique self-adjoint closure of the compact boundaryless elliptic covariant Laplacian
theorem_contract.poincare_vector: K=x cross xdot+(q/2)x is conserved with K dot x=q/2 and norm squared 2E+q^2/4
theorem_contract.positive_energy_orbits: every E>0 trajectory is a primitive oriented small circle of period 2pi/sqrt(2E+q^2/4)
theorem_contract.sign_reversal: x_q(-t) with reversed initial velocity solves charge -q and traverses the same geometric circle oppositely; bundle conjugation preserves spectrum
theorem_contract.spectrum: lambda_nq=n(n+abs(q)+1)+abs(q)/2 with multiplicity 2n+abs(q)+1 for every n>=0
